description: This file contains unit tests for the Control class in the Rialto client module, using Google Test framework. It tests creation, registration, and unregistration of clients within the Rialto control interface.

classes.name: RialtoClientControlTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for testing the Control class in Rialto client module.

methods.name: CreateDestroy
methods.description: Tests creation and destruction of the Control object.

methods.name: RegisterAndUnregisterClient
methods.description: Tests registering and unregistering a client with the Control object.

methods.description: Tests behavior when registering a null control client.

methods.name: RegisterClientFailureDueToOperationFailure
methods.description: Tests behavior when registration fails due to underlying operation failure.
